newsitem.title: LATVIA: RIETUMU BANK INVESTMENT PORTFOLIO UP 200 PCT.
newsitem.headline: RIETUMU BANK INVESTMENT PORTFOLIO UP 200 PCT.

text.p: Rietumu Bank said on Wednesday that the value of its investment portfolio has risen 208 percent since the start of the year to 66.48 million lats in the first seven months.
The bank said in a statement that the weightings of its investments have already changed.

The bank is now investing mainly in Ukrainian T-bills at 40.79 percent, Russian shares and debt at 38.92 percent, U.S. debt and shares at 11.32 percent, Latvian T-bills at 4.12 percent and Moldovan state paper at 3.93 percent.
This compared with investments at the end of 1996 at 55 percent in Russian state debt at 55 percent, Ukraine 12 percent, U.S. 20 percent, Latvia 10 percent and CIS states at three percent.
